tonight.headline: Bye holes filled; two coin flips left, both waiting on practice
body: Bad news first: Rashee Rice still has no practice since early October — ESPN moved him from OUT to QUESTIONABLE today with no report behind it — and Green Bay have not decided whether Josh Jacobs plays.

Stroud and Gordon are in for the bye players; the lineup as set projects 119.9 against Furia Regia's 111.6, 54% on ESPN. The projection lineup is 1.1 higher on two coin flips — Rice for Pickens and Jacobs for Gordon — and both wait for this week's practice reports. Nothing to claim before 01:00.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: Rice or Jacobs moved in on hope and then inactive with no executable fallback. Pickens plays Monday, so Rice's is safe; Gordon locks at 11:00 before Jacobs's 12:55 inactive call, so Jacobs's is not.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Furia Regia replace McLaurin (season-ending, in their lineup) with Jefferson from their bench — about 18.6 more on their side.

case.label: The player
case.body: Off the Exempt List Monday; the NFL investigation is still open (Yahoo 18 Oct). LaFleur 'hasn't decided' on Sunday (DK Network 20 Oct). No practice since August.

case.label: Contested
case.body: Pelissero reported on 17 Oct that he returns as the starter immediately, no ramp-up (Heavy). That is a role claim; LaFleur's Monday word is about availability. I take LaFleur's side until a practice report says otherwise.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Friday's Packers report shows no designation after full Thursday and Friday practices. Any designation, or no clear word by Sunday 10:30, and Gordon stays.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: The swap is made and Gordon outscores Jacobs (archive).

case.label: The gap
case.body: 13.5 against 13.3: inside the two-point line, so the projection decides and no thesis is written.

case.label: Why not now
case.body: ESPN moved him from OUT to QUESTIONABLE today with no report behind it — DK Network's 13:31Z report still has hamstring and knee, status TBD, and he did not practise in Week 6. A designation is a label; practice is the evidence.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Limited or full practice by Friday and no OUT tag: swap him in for Pickens. If he is inactive at 16:50 Sunday, swap Pickens back — his game is Monday.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: The swap is made and Pickens outscores Rice (archive).

whatWentWrong.title: The lineup tool's Jacobs contingency would fire too late
whatWentWrong.lead: It says check at 12:55 Sunday; Gordon's game starts at 11:00.

case.label: What happened
case.body: lineup_check.py prints 'if inactive at Sun 12:55 CDMX, start Gordon' — but Gordon is locked by then. Followed literally, an inactive Jacobs scores zero.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: Gordon stays in; Jacobs comes in only on Friday's evidence (the first card above). Rice's contingency does not have the problem: Pickens plays Monday.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: ESPN's lock in this league is per-slot rather than per-player — it is not; a started player cannot be benched.

whatWentWrong.sources: lineup_check.py output · ESPN league file kickoffs

whatWentWrong.title: Week 6 was won with 9.9 left on the bench
whatWentWrong.lead: Stroud's 23.0 sat behind Daniels's 19.0; Worthy's 14.3 behind Garrett Wilson's 8.4.

case.label: The numbers
case.body: 150.8 to 88.62 over Los Cachanillas; best possible 160.7 (week-6 archive, recomputed this run).

case.label: The lesson
case.body: Both were projection calls that lost — no override, nothing to fix but to keep starting by projection, which is why Rice's card waits on practice rather than on a hunch.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: A projection-set Week 7 lineup leaves more than 15 points on the bench (archive).

moves.reason: Not a value call — a timing one. Jacobs has not practised since August and LaFleur has not decided on Sunday (DK Network, Tuesday 20 Oct 13:31Z — after projections set, but Monday's 'possible' was already priced). Green Bay's inactives come at 12:55 CDMX, after Gordon's 11:00 kickoff, so the printed contingency cannot execute. Reverts to Jacobs if Friday's report clears him.
